classes.name: Project
classes.description: Represents a project in the OrangeHRM system, with properties for ID, customer association, name, description, deletion status, and project administrators, with ORM mappings for database integration.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the project.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the project.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer associated with this project.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a customer with this project.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the project.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the project.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the project is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the project as deleted or not.

methods.name: getProjectAdmins
methods.description: Returns the collection of project administrators.
